title: AutoInspect — power-line drone inspection
description: Custom inspection viewer for a drone LiDAR survey of a high-voltage line in Valais (50.6 million points, UTM 32N). Toggle automatic-classification layers (pylons, cables, insulators, vegetation, water, buildings, ground types), browse 103 oriented DJI photos placed at their camera poses, and play the scripted camera flight.
notes: Hand-written page with its own bundled libs/ (older Potree build). Class sub-clouds live in pointclouds/classes/, oriented photos in images/.
